Game Overview

In Popup Windows, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the exhilarating chaos of Popup Windows, where quick reflexes are your best ally. Battle an insidious virus by rapidly closing endless pop-up windows to prevent your screen's takeover. As windows multiply, your swift actions and strategic closing will be the key to survival in this addictive arcade adventure.
